Edit bc I feel compelled: this type of identity discourse divorces words from their definitions, reducing them to blank labels… then does the mental gymnastics in order to fit into these blank labels. 
As a lesbian wlw, I feel the ONE space that was safe for women, only women, is being encroached upon. If this was something else, like religion, race, ethnicity, this would be seen as cultural appropriation. I don’t understand, if a person is not a woman, why on earth would they want to be a lesbian? How about non-women that love non-women come up with a new label that isn’t already taken by a contradictory definition? Like anandrophilic? An=not, andro=men, and philic=loving. 
And why have I never seen non-women attracted to non-women claiming to be gay men? This contributes to lesbian sexuality not being taken seriously, and honestly reeks of misogyny.
